about: Shared table for the permits(rightsUsed, surface) contract (PLAN 4.2, 6.1; ADR 0006). Run by pytest (tests/v2/test_rights.py) and Vitest (packages/core/src/rights.test.ts) so the two bodies cannot drift. These rows describe M0's default body: allow on the local surface, deny on every other. M6 replaces the body with the rights register table and extends this file.

cases.name: local surface allows display of directly sourced data
local surface allows v1 legacy data (interim rule point 3)
local surface allows a derived series with mixed inputs
staging denies even directly sourced data until the register exists
production denies directly sourced data until the register exists
production denies a derived series with mixed inputs
a surface in the wrong case is denied
an empty lineage is denied even locally: nothing can be shown without saying where it came from
